versos.texto_bv: Depois disso, os filhos de Moabe e os filhos de Amom vieram com alguns dos amonitas para guerrear contra Josafá.
versos.traducao_literal: E aconteceu, depois disso: vieram os filhos de Moabe e os filhos de Amom, e com eles alguns dos amonitas, contra Josafá para a guerra.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): O terceiro grupo beligerante é chamado 'amonitas', o mesmo gentílico já usado para 'os filhos de Amom' na mesma frase, tornando a lista redundante/confusa. — evidência: NTLH: 'junto com os meunitas'; ARA: 'e com eles alguns dos meunitas'; NVIPT: 'com alguns dos meunitas' — as três referências convergem em 'meunitas' (povo distinto dos amonitas), não 'amonitas'.

kjv.texto: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

vizinhos.2: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazon–tamar, which is En–gedi.

web.texto: After this, the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

vizinhos.2: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).

versos.texto_bv: Alguns vieram e informaram Josafá: “Uma grande multidão vem contra você do outro lado do mar, de Arã. Eles já estão em Hazazom-Tamar, isto é, En-Gedi.”
versos.traducao_literal: E vieram e anunciaram a Josafá, dizendo: “Vem contra você multidão grande, do outro lado do mar, de Arã; e eis que eles em Hazazom-Tamar — ela é En-Gedi.”
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): A origem do exército invasor é dada como 'Arã', enquanto as três referências indicam 'Edom'. — evidência: NTLH: 'do país de Edom'; ARA: 'uma grande multidão de Edom'; NVIPT: 'vem contra ti de Edom' — convergência total em 'Edom', não 'Arã'.

kjv.texto: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazon–tamar, which is En–gedi.

vizinhos.1: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
vizinhos.3: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the Lord, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

web.texto: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).

vizinhos.1: After this, the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
vizinhos.3: Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek to Yahweh. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

versos.texto_bv: Josafá e seu povo vieram saquear o despojo deles e encontraram entre eles, em abundância, bens, cadáveres e objetos valiosos. Tomaram para si mais do que podiam carregar. Passaram três dias saqueando o despojo, pois era muito.
versos.traducao_literal: E veio Josafá e seu povo para saquear o despojo deles, e encontraram neles em abundância bens, cadáveres e objetos de coisas desejáveis, e despojaram para eles até não haver carga; e estiveram dias, três, saqueando o despojo, pois muito ele.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Na lista de despojo saqueado ('bens, cadáveres e objetos valiosos'), o item 'cadáveres' diverge das três referências, que descrevem bens materiais (gado/animais de carga/equipamentos), não corpos. — evidência: NTLH: 'animais de carga, armas, roupas e objetos de valor'; ARA: 'gado em grande número, objetos de valor e roupas, assim como jóias preciosas'; NVIPT: 'grande quantidade de equipamentos e roupas, e também objetos de valor' — nenhuma menciona corpos na lista de saque.

kjv.texto: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.

vizinhos.24: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
vizinhos.26: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the Lord: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.

web.texto: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in taking the plunder, it was so much.

vizinhos.24: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were no one who escaped.
vizinhos.26: On the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Beracah; for there they blessed Yahweh: therefore the name of that place was called The valley of Beracah to this day.
